text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, too firm...!
This hug feeling,
I can't relax at all...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One holiday. When I went to a furniture store, I saw Taiki Shuttle tilting her head in thought in the bedding section.
choice_data_list: Hey. What are you looking at?
Hey there. What are you looking at?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Trainer!
I'm looking for a new body pillow!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: My old ones are all tattered and... Jeez Louise! But I just can't find "the one"!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Still, never give up! I refuse to com-pro-mise!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~... Hugging you is way too fluffy, yes.
It's actually doing the opposite of calming me down, no...

text_block_list.name: Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, customer?
If you are searching for an exceptional artisanal piece, our main store has quite a selection—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, so many! With this many,
we'll definitely find the perfect fit!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~... They're all good, but none of them
have that comforting feel
like my "old body pillow" did...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
The moment we hugged,
my heart felt all warm and fuzzy...
choice_data_list: Come to think of it, what was your previous pillow like?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
This is a body pillow I brought from my home country!
When I hug it, visions of my hometown
come flooding back into my mind!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"A farm gently floats into my heart,
like coming back to my home...!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Before sleeping, hugging pillows with
my sisters and talking!
So many memories, good times!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Even when I first came to Japan and felt homesick,
I'd hug tight and remember happy thoughts, yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It seems she cares less about how comfortable the pillow is to hug, and more about whether it "reminds her of home." If that's the case—
choice_data_list: Taiki, could you try this out for me?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay. —Hmm, what is this?
It has such a strange touch to it~

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mgyuuu~~. ...Mmm? The hugging comfort
is... kinda just ordinary, though...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
“Still... what is zis?
My heart feels all 'fluffy'...
Oh, it's almost like—...”

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—A hay bed on the farm...!
Just like when taking an afternoon nap in the shed...!
choice_data_list: It's a rush-grass pillow. Smells nice, doesn't it?
It's a rush-grass pillow. Smells nice, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Smell? ...*sniff, sniff*

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
――! You are right!
It smells just like the hay back on the farm, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Basking in the warm sun, with this soft, lovely
fragrance in the air... Hehe♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I have DECIDED!
I'll go with this body pillow!
choice_data_list: I'm glad we found a good one.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! Thank you
so much for choosing me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~... A new body pillow...♪
It's... very good...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
So fluffy, so nice to hug...
Doing this makes me... *yawn*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
(Come to think of it... they used to come pick me up, too.
Whenever I was dozing off, Papa and the others would...)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
(No matter where on the vast farm I take a nap...
you always see right through me and know where I am, yes...)
"Heeey, Taiki!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, Trainer!
What brings you here?
I'm surprised you figured out I was napping here!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"I can see right through where you're hiding"—is that so?
Wow, really!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still... fufu♪ That's right!
No matter *where* you are, you'll definitely find me, yes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
You're always watching over me,
and always 'giving' me peace of mind――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Because you are my veeeery dependable
Japanese family!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taiki... *giggle*♪
You must really love that body pillow, huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Mnh-mnh...
Trai~ner...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Good morning!
I'm feeling refreshed and full of energy this morning desu~!
choice_data_list: Looks like you had a good dream!
Looks like you had a nice dream!
So, how was the body pillow?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Good morning!
I'm feeling refreshed and full of energy this morning desu~!
choice_data_list: Looks like you had a good dream!
Looks like you had a nice dream!
So, how was the body pillow?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the dream I had yesterday?
Weeell...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Welcome to my home, Trainer!
Over here! This way!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
First up is my home-style barbecue!
See, smells good, doesn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes, flipping the meat now!
Trainer, eat looooots, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Once we finish eating, I'll give you a tour of my favorite
spot! Let's get running!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh!
It was such a wonderful dream, yes♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! I had a barbecue
with my family in my dream!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
We talked so much and ate so much!
It was so fun!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: B-But! Next time, I want to have a dream where I get to play with you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I slept like a baby last night, yes!
The body pillow you recommended to me, Trainer,
is super relaxing!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Full of energy and skin so smooth!
I've got power to spare, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I simply CANNOT resist running any longer!
Go! Go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle dashed off cheerfully.
Blending in with the morning light,
her steps were boundlessly light.
